description: A yellow mancala board with several small pits filled with green, blue, and clear glass stones sits on a red bedspread in front of a white pillow. The right hand reaches in from the right, pinches a few stones from a pit on the right side, lifts them into the palm, then moves back over the next pits to drop and distribute the stones one by one; the board remains a right-hand object during the pick-up and release while the left hand is not visible.
